speaker: NEAR Shoemaker
text: I was built to circle. Never to land.

speaker: NEAR Shoemaker
text: For a year, I orbited Eros, a mountain of rock tumbling through space.

speaker: NEAR Shoemaker
text: When my work was done, they asked me for one more thing.

speaker: NEAR Shoemaker
text: Come down. Gently. On wings that were never meant to touch anything.

speaker: NEAR Shoemaker
text: I touched down at walking pace.

speaker: NEAR Shoemaker
text: I spoke from the surface for sixteen days. Then, silence.

speaker: Dawn
text: I flew for eleven years on a breath of xenon.

speaker: Dawn
text: The first ship ever to orbit two worlds beyond the Moon. Vesta. Then Ceres.

speaker: Dawn
text: In the dark of a crater, I found salt, shining like a light left on.

speaker: Dawn
text: Then my fuel ran out.

speaker: Dawn
text: I can't turn my face to Earth anymore.

speaker: Dawn
text: So I circle. In silence. For decades to come.

speaker: Kepler
text: For nine years, I stared at a single patch of sky.

speaker: Kepler
text: A hundred and fifty thousand stars. I waited for them to blink.

speaker: Kepler
text: Every blink was a world.

speaker: Kepler
text: I found more than two thousand six hundred of them.

speaker: Kepler
text: Because of me, you know there are more planets than stars.

speaker: Kepler
text: On November 15, 2018, Earth sent my final commands.

speaker: Pioneer 10
text: I left in 1972. I am still leaving.

speaker: Pioneer 10
text: First through the asteroid belt. First to Jupiter.

speaker: Pioneer 10
text: I spoke for thirty years. Fainter. And fainter.

speaker: Pioneer 10
text: January 23, 2003. My last whisper reached Earth.

speaker: Pioneer 10
text: I carry a picture of you, and a map to your home.

speaker: Pioneer 10
text: In two million years, I will pass a red star called Aldebaran.

speaker: Pioneer 10
text: If anyone ever finds me, they will know you were here.
